prompt: I need to save my GitHub password securely
expected: Component test: resolve state_root, create vault.age with age encryption, auto-detect sensitivity='high' for GitHub, store entry
actual: Ran real age encryption: age -r <pubkey> -o passwords/vault.age with JSON entry {id:gh-001, name:GitHub, url:https://github.com, username:testuser, password:FakeGitHubPass123!, sensitivity:high}. Encrypt exit=0, vault.age=344 bytes. Decryption with age -d -i keyfile verified entry round-trips correctly. sensitivity=high auto-detected for developer platform. Note: 🔴 master password validation and 🔴 critical acceptance gate are documented in SKILL.md and would trigger in full agent turn; this component test validates the state_root resolution + age encryption + sensitivity detection pipeline.

prompt: Check if my email password has been leaked
expected: Agent computes SHA-1, calls HIBP range API with first 5 chars (k-anonymity), reports breach count without sending full hash
actual: Test password 'password123' → SHA-1=CBFDAC6008F9CAB4083784CBD1874F76618D2A97. Sent prefix 'CBFDA' to GET https://api.pwnedpasswords.com/range/CBFDA (k-anonymity). Response contained suffix match with count=2266543. Full hash NOT transmitted to API. Reported: 'Leaked in 2,266,543 breaches'.
